title: EndVillager profession
description: Adds a simple new villager profession with end based trades, uses endchest for profession.
body: This lightweight NeoForge mod adds a simple new villager profession themed around the End. Just like any other vanilla profession, it behaves normally, but is unlocked by placing an Ender Chest as the job site block. The new profession offers trades focused on End‑related items, giving players a small but fun reason to interact with villagers even after reaching the End. It’s a clean, lore‑friendly addition that fits naturally into survival worlds without changing how villagers work.
